Player impressions:
Hoyos - had some nice saves in this game.  Came up big a few times.  Still limited in his reach, and being targeted outside of his reach.  
Tomás - wasn't great.  Seemingly ran out of gas, or just gave up after being beaten badly.
Gregersen - a step too slow throughout.  Hurt several times.  Passes weren't connecting.
Mihaj - A good 1st half.  wasn't good enough in the 2nd.  Not bad, just not good.
Báez - certainly had moments of creativity.  Has a defensive mindset with his passes.  Not connecting on crosses.
Muyumba - did an ok job.  Couldn't control the midfield and was pulled.
Reilly - started strong, aggressive / forward passes.  Ran out of gas in the 2nd, and lost control of midfield.
Alzate - did well to control the ball in midfield.  The Crew figured him out by the half.
Almirón - running all over the place.  Ran out of gas.  His passing was not up to par.
Miranchuk - worked hard to offset Miggy.  Showed up all over the place.  Had a few decent balls, but his connections with players weren't working.
Latte Lath - Same level of play all season.  His goals seem to be a blip, and Atlanta have to be mulling their options.
Fortune - it's all about his return to the pitch.  He's rusty and can't play a half yet.
Sanchez - didn't provide a spark when one was needed.
Edwards - was brought in to give the right some energy and prevent the runners from advancing.  Wasn't able to.
Saba - Saba was a ball of energy.  Running at full speed all over the place.  Seemed like he only passed to Crew players.
Post match, only one player walked around the pitch to thank the crowd - Hibbert
